original_english: Life begins when a single cell divides itself several times to give rise to a large number of cells.
hinglish_roman: Life tab shuru hoti hai jab ek single cell kai baar divide hoke bahut saari cells banata hai.

original_english: These cells gradually form the skin, muscles, bones, nerves and all other organs.
hinglish_roman: Yeh cells dheere-dheere skin, muscles, bones, nerves aur baaki saare organs banate hain.

original_english: A tissue is a group of cells similar in structure that work together to perform a specific function.
hinglish_roman: Tissue aise cells ka group hota hai jo structure mein similar hote hain aur ek specific function perform karte hain.

original_english: In multicellular organisms, cells of similar type performing similar functions group together to form a tissue.
hinglish_roman: Multicellular organisms mein similar type ke cells jo similar functions perform karte hain, mil ke tissue banate hain.

original_english: The formation of different types of tissues leads to the division of labour, which increases efficiency.
hinglish_roman: Alag-alag types ke tissues banne se division of labour hoti hai, jisse body ki efficiency badh jaati hai.

original_english: Most plants are fixed in one place and do not move from place to place like animals.
hinglish_roman: Zyaadatar plants ek jagah fixed rehte hain aur animals ki tarah ek jagah se doosri jagah nahi jaate.

original_english: Plant cells have a cell wall that provides rigidity and strength.
hinglish_roman: Plant cells mein ek cell wall hoti hai jo unhe rigidity aur strength deti hai.

original_english: Without a rigid cell wall, animal cells can change shape easily, which helps in locomotion.
hinglish_roman: Rigid cell wall na hone ki wajah se animal cells aasaani se shape change kar sakti hain, jo locomotion mein help karta hai.

original_english: Meristematic tissue is made up of actively dividing cells.
hinglish_roman: Meristematic tissue actively divide hone waale cells se bana hota hai.

original_english: Roots grow only from their tips, which contain cells that divide continuously.
hinglish_roman: Roots sirf apni tips se hi grow karti hain, jahan continuously divide hone waale cells hote hain.

original_english: Apical meristem is located at the tips of roots and shoots, and helps plants grow in length.
hinglish_roman: Apical meristem roots aur shoots ki tips pe hota hai aur plants ko length mein grow karne mein help karta hai.

original_english: Lateral meristem is located along the circumference of stems and causes an increase in girth.
hinglish_roman: Lateral meristem stem ke circumference ke along hota hai aur stem ki girth badhata hai.

original_english: Annual growth rings on a tree trunk help scientists estimate the age of the tree.
hinglish_roman: Tree trunk ke annual growth rings dekh ke scientists tree ki age estimate kar sakte hain.

original_english: Intercalary meristem is located at the nodes and helps plants regenerate after being cut or grazed.
hinglish_roman: Intercalary meristem nodes pe hota hai aur plants ko cut ya graze hone ke baad regenerate karne mein help karta hai.

original_english: Grass grows back after being mowed because of the intercalary meristem present at the nodes of its stem.
hinglish_roman: Ghaas mow hone ke baad dobara ug aati hai kyunki uske stem ke nodes pe intercalary meristem hota hai.

original_english: Meristematic cells have thin walls, dense cytoplasm and a large prominent nucleus.
hinglish_roman: Meristematic cells ki walls thin hoti hain, cytoplasm dense hota hai aur nucleus bada aur prominent hota hai.

original_english: Meristematic cells lack vacuoles and are tightly packed with little intercellular space.
hinglish_roman: Meristematic cells mein vacuoles nahi hote aur yeh cells tightly packed hote hain jisme bahut kam intercellular space hoti hai.

original_english: Differentiation is the process by which meristematic tissue loses the ability to divide and becomes permanent tissue.
hinglish_roman: Differentiation woh process hai jisme meristematic tissue divide karne ki ability kho deta hai aur permanent tissue ban jaata hai.

original_english: Permanent tissues can be simple, composed of only one type of cell, or complex, composed of more than one type.
hinglish_roman: Permanent tissues simple ho sakte hain, jisme sirf ek type ki cells hoti hain, ya complex, jisme ek se zyada types ki cells hoti hain.

original_english: Epidermis forms the outermost layer of the plant body and protects all parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Epidermis plant body ki sabse bahari layer hoti hai aur plant ke sabhi parts ko protect karti hai.

original_english: Epidermal cells are covered with a waxy layer of cutin called cuticle, which reduces water loss.
hinglish_roman: Epidermal cells ke upar cutin ki ek waxy layer hoti hai jise cuticle kehte hain, jo water loss kam karta hai.

original_english: Root hairs increase the surface area for absorption of water and minerals from the soil.
hinglish_roman: Root hairs surface area badhate hain jisse mitti se water aur minerals absorb karna aasaan ho jaata hai.

original_english: Stomata in leaves help in gaseous exchange and also in transpiration.
hinglish_roman: Leaves mein stomata gaseous exchange mein aur transpiration mein bhi help karte hain.

original_english: Parenchyma consists of living cells with thin walls and intercellular spaces, and mainly stores food.
hinglish_roman: Parenchyma mein thin walls waale living cells hote hain jinke beech intercellular spaces hoti hain, aur yeh mainly food store karta hai.

original_english: In aquatic plants, specialised parenchyma forms air spaces that help them float.
hinglish_roman: Aquatic plants mein specialised parenchyma air spaces banata hai jisse woh plants paani mein float kar sakti hain.

original_english: Collenchyma has living cells with unevenly thickened corners due to pectin deposition.
hinglish_roman: Collenchyma mein living cells hoti hain jinke corners pectin jamne ki wajah se uneven tarike se thick ho jaate hain.

original_english: Collenchyma provides support and flexibility, allowing stems and tendrils to bend without breaking.
hinglish_roman: Collenchyma support aur flexibility deta hai, jisse stems aur tendrils bina toote jhuk sakte hain.

original_english: Sclerenchyma cells have thick walls due to lignin deposition, making them hard and strong.
hinglish_roman: Sclerenchyma cells ki walls lignin jamne ki wajah se thick hoti hain, jisse yeh cells kaafi hard aur strong hoti hain.

original_english: Sclerenchyma cells are mostly dead and are found in stems, leaf veins, and hard coverings like coconut husk.
hinglish_roman: Sclerenchyma cells zyaadatar dead hoti hain aur stems, leaf veins aur coconut husk jaise hard coverings mein milti hain.

original_english: Xylem transports water and minerals from the roots to other parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Xylem roots se paani aur minerals plant ke baaki hisson tak transport karta hai.

original_english: Xylem consists of tracheids, vessels, xylem parenchyma and xylem fibres.
hinglish_roman: Xylem mein tracheids, vessels, xylem parenchyma aur xylem fibres hote hain.

original_english: Xylem parenchyma is the only living component of xylem; tracheids, vessels and xylem fibres are dead.
hinglish_roman: Xylem parenchyma xylem ka ekelauta living component hai; tracheids, vessels aur xylem fibres dead hote hain.

original_english: Phloem transports food prepared in leaves to other parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Phloem leaves mein bana hua khaana plant ke doosre hisson tak le jaata hai.

original_english: Phloem consists of sieve tubes, companion cells, phloem parenchyma and phloem fibres.
hinglish_roman: Phloem mein sieve tubes, companion cells, phloem parenchyma aur phloem fibres hote hain.

original_english: Companion cells regulate the loading and unloading of sugars in sieve tubes.
hinglish_roman: Companion cells sieve tubes mein sugars ka loading aur unloading regulate karti hain.

original_english: Plant tissues are organised into three tissue systems: dermal, ground and vascular.
hinglish_roman: Plant tissues teen tissue systems mein organised hote hain: dermal, ground aur vascular.

original_english: The dermal tissue system forms the outer covering of the plant, protecting it and reducing water loss.
hinglish_roman: Dermal tissue system plant ki bahari covering banata hai, plant ko protect karta hai aur water loss kam karta hai.

original_english: The ground tissue system forms the main body of the plant and includes parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma.
hinglish_roman: Ground tissue system plant ka main body banata hai aur isme parenchyma, collenchyma aur sclerenchyma aate hain.

original_english: Epithelial tissue forms the outer covering of the body and lines the internal organs.
hinglish_roman: Epithelial tissue body ki bahari covering banata hai aur internal organs ko andar se line karta hai.

original_english: Epithelial tissue is composed of closely packed cells with very little space between them.
hinglish_roman: Epithelial tissue mein cells bahut closely packed hoti hain, jinke beech bahut kam space hoti hai.

original_english: Blood is a connective tissue that transports nutrients, gases and hormones throughout the body.
hinglish_roman: Blood ek connective tissue hai jo poore body mein nutrients, gases aur hormones transport karta hai.

original_english: Red blood cells contain haemoglobin, an iron-rich protein that gives blood its red colour.
hinglish_roman: Red blood cells mein haemoglobin hota hai jo ek iron-rich protein hai aur blood ko laal rang deta hai.

original_english: Platelets help in blood clotting at the site of injury.
hinglish_roman: Platelets chot ki jagah pe blood clotting mein help karte hain.

original_english: White blood cells collect at infected areas causing redness, swelling and possible pus formation.
hinglish_roman: White blood cells infected areas mein jama hote hain jisse laalipan, sujan aur kabhi-kabhi pus bhi ban jaata hai.

original_english: Bone is a hard connective tissue with a rigid matrix containing calcium and phosphorus.
hinglish_roman: Bone ek hard connective tissue hai jisme calcium aur phosphorus waala rigid matrix hota hai.

original_english: Cartilage has a soft jelly-like matrix that provides flexibility and cushions the ends of bones.
hinglish_roman: Cartilage mein soft jelly-jaisi matrix hoti hai jo flexibility deti hai aur bones ke ends ko cushion karti hai.

original_english: Tendons connect muscles to bones and transmit the force generated by muscle contraction.
hinglish_roman: Tendons muscles ko bones se connect karte hain aur muscle contraction se jo force aati hai use bone tak pahunchaate hain.

original_english: Ligaments connect bones to bones and prevent excessive movement at joints.
hinglish_roman: Ligaments bones ko bones se connect karte hain aur joints pe zyada movement rokthe hain.

original_english: Skeletal muscles are responsible for voluntary movements and are attached to the skeleton.
hinglish_roman: Skeletal muscles voluntary movements ke liye zimmedaar hote hain aur skeleton se attached hote hain.

original_english: Skeletal muscle fibres are long, cylindrical, unbranched and multinucleate with light and dark striations.
hinglish_roman: Skeletal muscle fibres lambe, cylindrical, unbranched aur multinucleate hote hain aur inme light-dark striations dikhayi deti hain.

original_english: Smooth muscles are found in organs like the stomach and intestines and control involuntary movements.
hinglish_roman: Smooth muscles stomach aur intestines jaisi jagah mein hoti hain aur involuntary movements control karti hain.

original_english: Smooth muscle cells are spindle-shaped, have a single nucleus and lack striations.
hinglish_roman: Smooth muscle cells spindle-shaped hoti hain, ek hi nucleus hota hai aur inme striations nahi hote.

original_english: Cardiac muscles are found only in the heart and work continuously without fatigue.
hinglish_roman: Cardiac muscles sirf dil mein hoti hain aur bina thake lagaataar kaam karti rehti hain.

original_english: Cardiac muscle fibres are cylindrical, branched with a single nucleus and have faint striations.
hinglish_roman: Cardiac muscle fibres cylindrical aur branched hote hain, ek nucleus hota hai aur inme halki striations hoti hain.

original_english: Nervous tissue forms the body's control and coordination network.
hinglish_roman: Nervous tissue body ke control aur coordination network ka kaam karta hai.

original_english: Neurons are the basic cells of nervous tissue, specialised to receive, process and transmit messages.
hinglish_roman: Neurons nervous tissue ki basic cells hain jo messages receive, process aur transmit karne ke liye specialised hoti hain.

original_english: Each neuron has three main parts: a cell body, dendrites and an axon.
hinglish_roman: Har neuron ke teen main parts hote hain: cell body, dendrites aur axon.

original_english: Dendrites receive signals from other neurons, while the axon carries messages away from the cell body.
hinglish_roman: Dendrites doosre neurons se signals receive karte hain, jabki axon messages cell body se door le jaata hai.

original_english: The musculoskeletal system consists of bones, muscles, joints, cartilage, tendons and ligaments.
hinglish_roman: Musculoskeletal system mein bones, muscles, joints, cartilage, tendons aur ligaments aate hain.

original_english: The adult human skeleton makes up about 12 to 15 percent of body weight.
hinglish_roman: Ek adult insaan ka skeleton body weight ka lagbhag 12 se 15 percent hota hai.

original_english: The ball and socket joint at the shoulder allows movement forward, backward, sideways and in circles.
hinglish_roman: Shoulder pe ball and socket joint hoti hai jo aage, peeche, side mein aur gol-gol movement allow karta hai.

original_english: Hinge joints, like those in the elbow and knee, allow bending in only one direction.
hinglish_roman: Hinge joints, jaise elbow aur knee mein hoti hain, sirf ek direction mein jhukne deti hain.

original_english: The pivot joint connecting the skull to the backbone allows the head to move side to side.
hinglish_roman: Khopdi aur backbone ko jodhne waala pivot joint sar ko ek taraf se doosri taraf hilane deta hai.

original_english: The bones of the skull are connected by fixed joints, which keep the brain safe.
hinglish_roman: Khopdi ki bones fixed joints se judi hoti hain, jo brain ko surakshit rakhti hain.

original_english: The vertebral column or backbone is made up of small bones called vertebrae.
hinglish_roman: Vertebral column ya backbone chote-chote bones se bana hota hai jinhe vertebrae kehte hain.

original_english: Between each vertebra is a cartilage disc that acts as a cushion and allows flexibility.
hinglish_roman: Har do vertebrae ke beech ek cartilage disc hoti hai jo cushion ki tarah kaam karti hai aur flexibility deti hai.

original_english: The rib cage consists of 12 pairs of ribs and protects vital organs like the heart and lungs.
hinglish_roman: Rib cage mein 12 jodon ki pasliyaan hoti hain jo dil aur lungs jaise vital organs ko protect karta hai.

original_english: Ribs are joined by flexible cartilage that allows the chest to expand and contract during breathing.
hinglish_roman: Pasliyaan flexible cartilage se judi hoti hain jo chest ko saas lete waqt pheelne aur sikodhne deta hai.

original_english: F.C. Steward demonstrated that even single phloem cells of carrot can regenerate a whole plant.
hinglish_roman: F.C. Steward ne dikhaya ki gajar ke phloem ki ek akeli cell bhi poora plant dobara bana sakti hai.

original_english: Totipotency is the ability of a mature cell to dedifferentiate, divide and develop into a complete new organism.
hinglish_roman: Totipotency ek mature cell ki woh ability hai jisme woh dedifferentiate hoke divide ho sakti hai aur ek poore naye organism mein develop ho sakti hai.

original_english: Agrobacterium tumefaciens causes crown gall disease, which leads to tumour-like swellings on plant stems.
hinglish_roman: Agrobacterium tumefaciens crown gall disease karta hai, jisme plant ke stems pe tumour-jaisi gaanthein bann jaati hain.

original_english: Stem cells in bone marrow are special cells that can divide and make new blood cells.
hinglish_roman: Bone marrow mein stem cells hoti hain jo special cells hain aur naye blood cells bana sakti hain.

original_english: Transpiration creates a pull in the xylem that helps water move up from roots to leaves.
hinglish_roman: Transpiration xylem mein ek pull create karta hai jo paani ko roots se leaves tak upar jaane mein help karta hai.

original_english: In unicellular organisms like amoeba, a single cell performs all functions of life.
hinglish_roman: Amoeba jaise unicellular organisms mein ek akeli cell hi zindagi ke saare kaam karti hai.

original_english: Sipra Guha Mukherjee and S.C. Maheshwari developed a complete plant through anther culture in a laboratory.
hinglish_roman: Sipra Guha Mukherjee aur S.C. Maheshwari ne laboratory mein anther culture se ek poora plant develop kiya.

original_english: Sclerenchyma cells have thick lignified walls and are mostly dead.
hinglish_roman: Sclerenchyma cells mein thin walls hoti hain aur yeh living cells hote hain.
hinglish_with_error: Sclerenchyma cells mein thin walls hoti hain aur yeh living cells hote hain.
error_word: thin walls hoti hain aur yeh living cells hote hain
correct_word: thick lignified walls hoti hain aur yeh mostly dead cells hote hain
explanation: Student ne sclerenchyma ki properties galat likhi hain. 'Thin walls' aur 'living' dono galat hain. Sclerenchyma ki walls thick aur lignified hoti hain aur yeh cells mostly dead hote hain. Yeh collenchyma ki properties se confuse ho sakti hain.

original_english: Xylem transports water and minerals from roots to other parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Xylem leaves se food ko roots tak transport karta hain.
hinglish_with_error: Xylem leaves se food ko roots tak transport karta hain.
explanation: 'Xylem' ek singular subject hai isliye 'karta hai' hona chahiye, 'karta hain' nahi. 'Hain' plural subjects ke saath use hota hai. Iske alawa yeh sentence factually bhi galat hai kyunki xylem food nahi balki water aur minerals transport karta hai - woh phloem ka kaam hai.

original_english: Tendons connect muscles to bones.
hinglish_roman: Tendons bones ko bones se connecting hain.
hinglish_with_error: Tendons bones ko bones se connecting hain.
explanation: Hinglish mein English present participle 'connecting' directly use karna galat hai. Sahi form hai 'connect karte hain' jisme English verb ke saath Hindi auxiliary 'karte hain' lagate hain. Yeh ek common intra-sentential mixing error hai.

original_english: Epithelial tissue forms the outer covering of the body.
hinglish_roman: Epithelial tissue body ke outer covering banata hai.
hinglish_with_error: Epithelial tissue body ke outer covering banata hai.
explanation: Hindi mein 'covering' feminine noun hai isliye 'ki' use hona chahiye, 'ke' nahi. 'Ke' masculine nouns ke saath use hota hai. Yeh ek common gender agreement mistake hai jo Hindi-English mixing mein frequently hoti hai.

original_english: Each neuron has three main parts: cell body, dendrites and axon.
hinglish_roman: Har neuron ke teen main parts hote hain: cell body, dendrites aur axons.
hinglish_with_error: Har neuron ke teen main parts hote hain: cell body, dendrites aur axons.
explanation: Ek neuron mein sirf ek axon hota hai, isliye 'axon' singular use hona chahiye. 'Axons' likh ke student ne galat pluralization ki hai. 'Dendrites' zaroor plural hai kyunki ek neuron mein multiple dendrites hote hain, lekin axon hamesha ek hi hota hai.

original_english: Life begins when a single cell divides itself several times to give rise to a large number of cells.
hinglish_roman: Life ek single cell se shuru hoti hai jo baar baar divide hoke bahut saari cells banati hai.

original_english: A tissue is a group of cells similar in structure that work together to perform a specific function.
hinglish_roman: Tissue un cells ka group hota hai jo structure mein similar hote hain aur ek specific function perform karte hain.

original_english: In multicellular organisms, cells of similar type performing similar function group together to form a tissue.
hinglish_roman: Multicellular organisms mein similar type ki cells jo similar function perform karti hain woh group hoke tissue banati hain.

original_english: In unicellular organisms like amoeba, a single cell performs all functions of life.
hinglish_roman: Amoeba jaise unicellular organisms mein ek hi cell life ke saare functions perform karti hai.

original_english: The formation of different types of tissues leads to division of labour, which increases efficiency of the body.
hinglish_roman: Alag alag tissues banne se division of labour hota hai, jisse body ki efficiency badh jaati hai.

original_english: What is a tissue and how is it formed?
hinglish_roman: Tissue kya hota hai aur yeh kaise banta hai?

original_english: Why don't unicellular organisms have tissues?
hinglish_roman: Unicellular organisms mein tissues kyun nahi hote?

original_english: How is a tissue formed from cells in multicellular organisms?
hinglish_roman: Multicellular organisms mein cells se tissue kaise banta hai?

original_english: How does division of labour happen because of tissues?
hinglish_roman: Division of labour tissues ki wajah se kaise hota hai?

original_english: Sir, why are plant and animal tissues different?
hinglish_roman: Sir, plant aur animal tissues alag kyun hote hain?

original_english: Meristematic tissue consists of actively dividing cells that help plants grow.
hinglish_roman: Meristematic tissue mein actively dividing cells hoti hain jo plant ko grow karne mein help karti hain.

original_english: Apical meristem is located at the tips of roots and shoots and helps plants grow in length.
hinglish_roman: Apical meristem root aur shoot ke tips par hota hai aur plant ko length mein grow karne mein help karta hai.

original_english: Lateral meristem is present along the circumference of the stem and increases girth.
hinglish_roman: Lateral meristem stem ke circumference ke around hota hai aur girth ko increase karta hai.

original_english: Intercalary meristem is located at the base of internodes and helps plants regenerate after cutting.
hinglish_roman: Intercalary meristem internode ke base par hota hai aur cutting ke baad plant ko regenerate hone mein help karta hai.

original_english: Cells of meristematic tissue have thin walls, dense cytoplasm and a large prominent nucleus.
hinglish_roman: Meristematic tissue ki cells mein thin walls, dense cytoplasm aur ek bada prominent nucleus hota hai.

original_english: What is the difference between apical meristem and lateral meristem?
hinglish_roman: Apical meristem aur lateral meristem mein kya difference hai?

original_english: Where is intercalary meristem found and what is its function?
hinglish_roman: Intercalary meristem kahan paya jaata hai aur iska kya kaam hai?

original_english: What is meristematic tissue and where is it found?
hinglish_roman: Meristematic tissue kya hai aur yeh kahan paya jaata hai?

original_english: Why does root growth stop when the tip is cut?
hinglish_roman: Roots ki growth stop kyun ho jaati hai jab tip cut kar diya jaata hai?

original_english: Why do meristematic cells not have vacuoles?
hinglish_roman: Meristematic cells mein vacuoles kyun nahi hote?

original_english: Meristematic tissue becomes permanent by the process of differentiation.
hinglish_roman: Differentiation ke process se meristematic tissue permanent tissue ban jaata hai.

original_english: Parenchyma consists of living cells with thin walls that are loosely packed with intercellular spaces.
hinglish_roman: Parenchyma living cells se bani hoti hai jinki walls thin hoti hain aur cells loosely packed hote hain intercellular spaces ke saath.

original_english: Parenchyma mainly stores food and also performs photosynthesis in green parts of plants.
hinglish_roman: Parenchyma mainly food store karta hai aur plants ke green parts mein photosynthesis bhi perform karta hai.

original_english: Collenchyma consists of living cells with unevenly thickened corners due to pectin deposition.
hinglish_roman: Collenchyma living cells se bana hota hai jinke corners pectin deposition ki wajah se unevenly thick ho jaate hain.

original_english: Collenchyma provides support and flexibility, allowing stems and tendrils to bend without breaking.
hinglish_roman: Collenchyma support aur flexibility deta hai, isliye stems aur tendrils bina toote bend kar sakte hain.

original_english: Sclerenchyma cells have thick walls due to deposition of lignin, making them hard and strong.
hinglish_roman: Sclerenchyma cells ki walls lignin deposition ki wajah se thick hoti hain, isliye yeh hard aur strong ho jaati hain.

original_english: Most sclerenchyma cells are dead and are found in stems, leaf veins and hard coverings of seeds.
hinglish_roman: Sclerenchyma ki zyaadatar cells dead hoti hain aur stems, leaf veins aur seeds ke hard coverings mein paayi jaati hain.

original_english: What is the difference between parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma?
hinglish_roman: Parenchyma, collenchyma aur sclerenchyma mein kya fark hai?

original_english: Why are sclerenchyma cells dead?
hinglish_roman: Sclerenchyma cells dead kyun hote hain?

original_english: How does collenchyma tissue make the stem flexible?
hinglish_roman: Collenchyma tissue stem ko flexible kaise banata hai?

original_english: What is differentiation and how does it happen?
hinglish_roman: Differentiation kya hoti hai aur yeh kaise hoti hai?

original_english: How does parenchyma perform photosynthesis?
hinglish_roman: Parenchyma photosynthesis kaise perform karta hai?

original_english: Xylem is the tissue that transports water and minerals from roots to other parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Xylem woh tissue hai jo roots se water aur minerals ko plant ke baaki parts tak transport karta hai.

original_english: Xylem consists of tracheids, vessels, xylem parenchyma and xylem fibres.
hinglish_roman: Xylem tracheids, vessels, xylem parenchyma aur xylem fibres se milkar bana hota hai.

original_english: Phloem is mostly made up of living cells and transports food from leaves to other parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Phloem mostly living cells se bana hota hai aur leaves se food ko plant ke baaki parts tak transport karta hai.

original_english: Sieve tubes transport food while companion cells regulate their function.
hinglish_roman: Sieve tubes food transport karti hain jabki companion cells unka function regulate karti hain.

original_english: The epidermis forms the outermost layer of the plant body and protects all parts of the plant.
hinglish_roman: Epidermis plant body ki outermost layer banati hai aur plant ke saare parts ko protect karti hai.

original_english: Stomata present in leaf epidermis help in gaseous exchange and transpiration.
hinglish_roman: Leaf epidermis mein present stomata gaseous exchange aur transpiration mein help karte hain.

original_english: What is the function of xylem and phloem?
hinglish_roman: Xylem aur phloem ka kya function hai?

original_english: What is the relation between sieve tubes and companion cells?
hinglish_roman: Sieve tubes aur companion cells mein kya relation hai?

original_english: What is the function of stomata?
hinglish_roman: Stomata ka kya kaam hota hai?

original_english: How does the epidermis protect the plant?
hinglish_roman: Epidermis plant ko kaise protect karti hai?

original_english: Epithelial tissue forms the outer covering of the body and also lines internal organs like the mouth and intestine.
hinglish_roman: Epithelial tissue body ki outer covering banata hai aur mouth aur intestine jaise internal organs ko bhi line karta hai.

original_english: Epithelial tissue is composed of closely packed cells with very little space between them.
hinglish_roman: Epithelial tissue closely packed cells se bana hota hai jinke beech mein bahut kam space hota hai.

original_english: A single layer of thin, flat cells helps in rapid diffusion of gases in the lungs.
hinglish_roman: Ek single layer of thin, flat cells lungs mein gases ke rapid diffusion mein help karti hai.

original_english: Many layers of tightly packed flat cells protect the skin and mouth from mechanical injury.
hinglish_roman: Many layers ki tightly packed flat cells skin aur mouth ko mechanical injury se protect karti hain.

original_english: Cells specialised for secretion produce mucus, enzymes, hormones and sweat.
hinglish_roman: Secretion ke liye specialised cells mucus, enzymes, hormones aur sweat produce karti hain.

original_english: Ciliated epithelial cells in the nostrils and inner ear perform sensory functions like smell and balance.
hinglish_roman: Nostrils aur inner ear mein ciliated epithelial cells smell aur balance jaisi sensory functions perform karti hain.

original_english: Columnar epithelial cells in the small intestine help in efficient absorption of nutrients.
hinglish_roman: Small intestine mein columnar epithelial cells nutrients ke efficient absorption mein help karti hain.

original_english: What is the main function of epithelial tissue?
hinglish_roman: Epithelial tissue ka main function kya hota hai?

original_english: Why is epithelial tissue in the lungs only a single layer?
hinglish_roman: Lungs mein epithelial tissue single layer ki kyun hoti hai?

original_english: What is the difference between squamous, columnar and cuboidal epithelium?
hinglish_roman: Squamous, columnar aur cuboidal epithelium mein kya difference hai?

original_english: Where are ciliated cells found and what is their function?
hinglish_roman: Ciliated cells kahan paayi jaati hain aur inka kya function hai?

original_english: How many layers of epithelial tissue are there in the skin?
hinglish_roman: Skin mein epithelial tissue kitni layers ki hoti hai?

original_english: A tissue that connects and supports other tissues is called connective tissue.
hinglish_roman: Jo tissue doosre tissues ko connect aur support karta hai use connective tissue kehte hain.

original_english: Blood is a connective tissue with a watery, fluid matrix, while bone has a hard, solid matrix.
hinglish_roman: Blood ek connective tissue hai jiska matrix watery aur fluid hota hai, jabki bone ka matrix hard aur solid hota hai.

original_english: Red blood cells contain haemoglobin, an iron-rich protein, and live for about four months.
hinglish_roman: Red blood cells mein haemoglobin hota hai, jo ek iron-rich protein hai, aur yeh cells lagbhag char mahine tak zinda rehti hain.

original_english: Platelets help in blood clotting at the site of an injury.
hinglish_roman: Platelets injury ki site par blood clotting mein help karte hain.

original_english: Cartilage has a soft, jelly-like matrix and provides flexibility and cushioning to joints.
hinglish_roman: Cartilage ka matrix soft aur jelly-like hota hai aur yeh joints ko flexibility aur cushioning deta hai.

original_english: Tendons connect muscles to bones, while ligaments connect bones to bones.
hinglish_roman: Tendons muscles ko bones se connect karte hain, jabki ligaments bones ko bones se connect karte hain.

original_english: Ligaments limit movement at a joint and help prevent dislocation.
hinglish_roman: Ligaments joint par movement ko limit karte hain aur dislocation ko prevent karne mein help karte hain.

original_english: Both blood and bone are connective tissue, so how are they different?
hinglish_roman: Blood aur bone dono connective tissue hai toh yeh alag kaise hain?

original_english: What is the function of platelets?
hinglish_roman: Platelets ka function kya hai?

original_english: What is the difference between a tendon and a ligament?
hinglish_roman: Tendon aur ligament mein kya fark hai?

original_english: How does cartilage give us flexibility?
hinglish_roman: Cartilage humein flexibility kaise deta hai?

original_english: What do white blood cells do during an infection?
hinglish_roman: White blood cells infection ke time kya karte hain?

original_english: Voluntary movements like running and writing are carried out by skeletal muscles attached to the skeleton.
hinglish_roman: Running aur writing jaisi voluntary movements skeleton se attached skeletal muscles ke through hoti hain.

original_english: Skeletal muscle fibres are unbranched, multinucleate and show light and dark bands called striations.
hinglish_roman: Skeletal muscle fibres unbranched, multinucleate hoti hain aur inmein light aur dark bands hoti hain jinhe striations kehte hain.

original_english: Smooth muscles found in the stomach and intestines help in slow, continuous movements like digestion.
hinglish_roman: Stomach aur intestines mein paayi jaane wali smooth muscles digestion jaisi slow, continuous movements mein help karti hain.

original_english: Smooth muscle cells are spindle-shaped, have a single nucleus and lack striations.
hinglish_roman: Smooth muscle cells spindle-shaped hoti hain, inmein single nucleus hota hai aur striations nahi hoti.

original_english: Cardiac muscles are found only in the heart and work tirelessly throughout life without fatigue.
hinglish_roman: Cardiac muscles sirf heart mein paayi jaati hain aur yeh poori zindagi bina thake tirelessly kaam karti hain.

original_english: Cardiac muscle fibres are cylindrical and branched with a single nucleus and faint striations.
hinglish_roman: Cardiac muscle fibres cylindrical aur branched hoti hain, inmein single nucleus aur faint striations hoti hain.

original_english: What is the difference between striated and smooth muscle?
hinglish_roman: Striated aur smooth muscle mein kya difference hota hai?

original_english: Why is cardiac muscle special?
hinglish_roman: Cardiac muscle special kyun hoti hai?

original_english: What is the difference between voluntary and involuntary movements?
hinglish_roman: Voluntary aur involuntary movements mein kya fark hai?

original_english: Where is smooth muscle found and what is its function?
hinglish_roman: Smooth muscle kahan paayi jaati hai aur iska kya function hai?

original_english: Why do skeletal muscles have striations?
hinglish_roman: Skeletal muscle mein striations kyun hote hain?

original_english: Which muscle works during digestion?
hinglish_roman: Digestion ke time kaunsi muscle kaam karti hai?

original_english: Nervous tissue forms the body's control and coordination network.
hinglish_roman: Nervous tissue body ke control aur coordination ka network banata hai.

original_english: Neurons are the cells of nervous tissue that receive, process and transmit messages.
hinglish_roman: Neurons nervous tissue ki cells hoti hain jo messages ko receive, process aur transmit karti hain.

original_english: Each neuron has a cell body, dendrites and an axon.
hinglish_roman: Har neuron mein ek cell body, dendrites aur ek axon hota hai.

original_english: The cell body contains the nucleus and controls the activities of the cell.
hinglish_roman: Cell body mein nucleus hota hai jo cell ki activities ko control karta hai.

original_english: Dendrites receive signals from other neurons and pass them to the cell body.
hinglish_roman: Dendrites doosre neurons se signals receive karte hain aur unhe cell body tak pahunchate hain.

original_english: The axon is a long fibre that carries messages from the cell to the axon terminals.
hinglish_roman: Axon ek long fibre hota hai jo messages ko cell se axon terminals tak carry karta hai.

original_english: During exercise, the brain signals the heart to beat faster to meet the body's increased oxygen demand.
hinglish_roman: Exercise ke time brain heart ko signal deta hai ki woh fast beat kare taaki body ki badhi hui oxygen demand puri ho sake.

original_english: What are the main parts of a neuron?
hinglish_roman: Neuron ke main parts kya hain?

original_english: What is the functional difference between dendrites and axon?
hinglish_roman: Dendrites aur axon mein kya kaam ka fark hai?

original_english: How does the brain signal the heart to beat faster?
hinglish_roman: Brain heart ko fast beat karne ka signal kaise deta hai?

original_english: How does nervous tissue coordinate the body?
hinglish_roman: Nervous tissue body ko coordinate kaise karta hai?

original_english: What is the function of axon terminals?
hinglish_roman: Axon terminals ka kya function hota hai?
